items.title: The AI Decoded Series
items.description: A comprehensive 5-part curriculum covering the foundations and future of artificial intelligence.

items.title: AI for Beginners
items.description: A hands-on introduction demystifying ChatGPT and exploring practical ways to make AI a helpful, approachable tool in your everyday routine.

items.title: How Businesses Can Effectively Use AI
items.description: Learn how local professionals can leverage AI for everyday efficiency and clear up the confusion surrounding this rapidly evolving technology.

items.title: The AI Administrative Assistant
items.description: Learn how to use AI to automate grueling daily office tasks, from summarizing meeting minutes to drafting multi-channel announcements.

items.title: The Future of School Leadership with AI
items.description: A workshop teaching school administrators how to use AI to draft newsletters, summarize evaluations, and save valuable time.

items.title: AI Career Search & ATS Optimization
items.description: Discover how AI recruiter filters work and learn to optimize your resume for Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) while maintaining your authentic human voice.

items.title: No-Code App Building
items.description: Build and deploy your first live web app or digital portfolio using free AI companions without writing a single line of code.

items.title: The Parent's Guide to AI Safety
items.description: Learn to protect your family from AI-generated scams like phone spoofing, while shifting AI from a potential hazard into a safe, constructive learning tool for your kids.

items.title: The Parent's Guide to AI Homework Companions
items.description: Shift AI from a 'cheating machine' to a patient, step-by-step Socratic tutor to safely guide your child's learning.

items.title: NotebookLM Masterclass
items.description: Learn how to transform your messy notes, meeting minutes, and research documents into powerful learning tools like custom podcasts, study guides, flashcards, and quizzes.

items.title: AI for Local Historians, Genealogists, and Writers
items.description: Bridge old archives with new tech by using multi-modal AI to decipher handwritten cursive, structure timelines, and brainstorm historical context.

items.title: Mastering the 30-Second Elevator Speech for Networking Success
items.description: Learn how to craft and deliver a compelling, memorable introduction for professional and community networking.

items.title: Effective Public Speaking Skills & Active Listening
items.description: Practical techniques for professional settings, covering vocal delivery, body language, message structure, and effective two-way communication.

items.title: Speak So Others Will Listen (Find Your Voice)
items.description: Walk away with interactive, immediate techniques to conquer stage fright, speak with confidence, and command an audience's attention.

items.title: Telling Tales: The Art of Storytelling
items.description: Listen, learn, and explore different styles of structuring and delivering personal narratives that connect with your audience.

items.title: Think on Your Feet
items.description: A highly interactive, improvisational speaking workshop designed to help you think quickly and respond eloquently under pressure.

items.title: Young Speakers Academy / Youth Leadership Program
items.description: A multi-week youth public speaking and leadership program covering speech structure, impromptu speaking, and debate, culminating in a live community showcase.

items.title: Teen Talk - Mastering Public Speaking
items.description: Practical tools to help teens become more effective and confident communicators for class presentations, interviews, and leadership roles.

items.title: Career Day Tech & AI Showcases
items.description: Engaging, hands-on sessions for students demonstrating software engineering, telecommunications, and real-time AI generation (music, art, and storytelling).

items.title: Week of Respect Presentation — Franklin School
items.description: A special presentation delivered at Franklin School during the Week of Respect, promoting kindness, inclusion, and positive communication among students.
